title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability… (CVE-2026-114529)
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal CSV Field allows Stored XSS. This issue affects CSV Field versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.10, from 3.0.0 to 3.0.7.
